continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: User asked whether prior CPU/RSS measurements omitted iptables. Clarification: exact WBD smoke run 32814277618 launches udp2raw with -a, so it is not literally firewall-free, but cpu_ms_total only sums WBD userspace process CPU and does not include all kernel netfilter/softirq work or OpenWrt-style routed FORWARD/NAT. The current sandbox lacks CAP_NET_ADMIN, so genuine iptables/netns tests cannot run locally. A local compiled C UDP relay was used only as a conservative userspace upper bound: for 100000 x 1200-byte echo transactions, direct median goodput ~1467.9 Mbps; one relay ~1200.2 Mbps with ~710 ms relay CPU for 200000 forwarded datagrams (~3.55 us/datagram) and ~1412 KiB RSS; two relays ~403.3 Mbps with ~2130 ms CPU and ~2832 KiB RSS, with an unstable repeat. This confirms userspace port forwarding materially overstates kernel netfilter cost. A better privileged kernel probe was added in scripts/bench_netfilter_overhead.py and tests/test_netfilter_bench_optional.py. CI run 32816368578, test job 97705372904, completed PASS at 300 Mbps UDP / 1200-byte datagrams / three repeats: plain routing median 299.889 Mbps, FORWARD+conntrack median 299.901 Mbps, DNAT+MASQUERADE+FORWARD median 299.901 Mbps, all with 0% loss. Conntrack median was 0 for plain route and 2 entries for filter/NAT. iperf remote CPU medians were 24.74% route, 27.05% filter and 29.29% NAT; this is a rough end-to-end signal, not isolated router CPU. Global /proc/stat busy-core medians were noisy/non-monotonic on the hosted runner (1.47 route, 1.03 filter, 2.05 NAT) and must not be used as precise incremental netfilter CPU. No throughput cliff was observed at 300 Mbps. The temporary [netfilter-bench] PR title flag was removed after capture. Existing WBD smoke RSS remains ~28-30 MiB aggregate across both peers, or roughly 13.2-14.9 MiB userspace per endpoint; UDPspeeder dominates memory. Kernel netfilter memory for a small ruleset and two conntrack entries is expected to be tiny relative to this userspace budget and should not be approximated by the ~1.4 MiB C relay RSS.
